# Neural Architect

> A high-fidelity, interactive professional portfolio by Farhan Mallick, designed to showcase the intersection of AI Agents, Immersive UX, and Data-Driven Architecture.

This repository serves as a professional portfolio and a playground for integrating advanced front-end technologies (Next.js, React, GSAP, Three.js) with intelligence layers (Supabase, Qdrant, Google GenAI, Groq).

Important notes:
- The project relies on a hybrid data model: static JSON ledgers (`src/data/`) for deterministic structures, and dynamic external APIs (GitHub, Supabase) for live proofs of work.
- It uses standard `npm` for dependency management and scripts (`npm run dev`, `npm run build`, `npm run lint`).
- Theming is built on native CSS variables injected at the `:root` level, managed by `ThemeContext.tsx`.

- [Development Guide](/docs/DEVELOPMENT.md): Guidelines for developing, styling, and animating components within the project.
- [Getting Started Guide](/docs/GETTING-STARTED.md): Instructions to bootstrap the project locally.
- [Testing Guide](/docs/TESTING.md): Overview of the testing strategy, including Vitest, Playwright, and manual QA procedures.
